name: Hikari Sena
want: join the club she saw at last year's culture festival, and be noticed by her senpai
secret: As a middle-schooler she saw the planetarium the player's year put on, chose Seiryo because of it, and keeps the ticket stub in her notebook.
voice: "Senpai! Senpai!", talks at double speed, salutes.
description: A first-year with more energy than sense; attaches herself to a senpai the first day.
appearance: Short orange hair with a star clip, an oversized cardigan, sneakers she was told not to wear.

agenda.goal: join the astronomy club and become the player's favourite kouhai
steps: hunts for the astronomy club room on her first day and gets lost in the old wing

steps.text: bursts in on the player, salutes and announces she is joining the club

steps: brings home-made star-shaped cookies to the club room
